title: Extension of Theorem A without hypotheses (a) and (b)
statement:
In the setup of the report—where $B_0$ is an indefinite rational quaternion algebra, $F$ is a real quadratic field with $\mathcal O_F=\mathbb Z[\sqrt{\Delta}]$, all primes dividing $\operatorname{disc}(B_0)$ split in $F$, and $M_0\hookrightarrow M$ is the stated closed immersion—prove that for every totally positive $\alpha\in\mathcal O_F$ and every totally positive $v=(v_1,v_2)\in F\otimes_{\mathbb Q}\mathbb R$, the arithmetic pullback satisfies

$$\widehat Y(\alpha,v)\longmapsto \sum_{T\in\Sigma(\alpha)}\widehat Z(T,v),$$
